categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies wallet scanning logic across src/wallet/scan.cpp and src/wallet/scan.h.
categories.rationale: Substantially cuts wallet rescan times by parallelizing BIP 157/158 filter checking across multiple threads. Benchmarks show a 4.5x to 7.8x speedup on multi-core systems (dropping 200,000 mainnet blocks from ~272s to ~35s), directly addressing slow wallet rescans highlighted as a priority concern in the wallet rubric.
